original_query: select min(i_brand_id), min(i_manufact_id),  	min(ss_ext_sales_price)  from date_dim, store_sales, item,customer,customer_address,store  where d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk    and ss_item_sk = i_item_sk    and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk    and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk    and ss_store_sk = s_store_sk    AND i_category  = 'Books'    and d_year=1999    and d_moy = 7    and substring(ca_zip,1,5) <> substring(s_zip,1,5)    and ca_state  = 'IN'    and c_birth_month = 10    and ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 77  ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
    MIN(i.i_brand_id) AS min_brand_id,
    MIN(i.i_manufact_id) AS min_manufact_id,
    MIN(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS min_ext_sales_price
FROM date_dim AS d
JOIN store_sales AS ss
  ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN item AS i
  ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
JOIN customer AS c
  ON c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address AS ca
  ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
JOIN store AS s
  ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
WHERE i.i_category = 'Books'
  AND d.d_year = 1999
  AND d.d_moy = 7
  AND substring(ca.ca_zip, 1, 5) <> substring(s.s_zip, 1, 5)
  AND ca.ca_state = 'IN'
  AND c.c_birth_month = 10
  AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 77;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Rewrote the implicit comma-join syntax into explicit INNER JOIN syntax for readability and clearer join ordering; no semantic change. All original WHERE predicates retained.

The non-sargable predicate substring(ca_zip,1,5) <> substring(s_zip,1,5) is applied after joins; since store has only 102 rows and result set is already filtered by date/category/state, this predicate is cheap and left unchanged. No redundant predicates found.

No CTE or subquery restructuring is needed - the query is a single flat aggregation over six tables. Recommend physical indexes: date_dim(d_year, d_moy, d_date_sk) and store_sales(ss_sold_date_sk, ss_wholesale_cost) INCLUDE (ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_store_sk, ss_ext_sales_price) to reduce heap access; secondary covering indexes on item(i_category), customer(c_birth_month), customer_address(ca_state) are lower priority.
